title: DeliveryRegion Schema
description: Schema for delivery regions in the baker's application

id.description: The unique identifier for the delivery region

storeId.description: The ID of the store that owns this delivery region

regionName.description: The name of the delivery region

postalCodes.description: Array of postal codes included in this delivery region

price.description: The delivery price for this region

radius.description: Radius of the delivery area in meters

coordinates.description: Geographical coordinates and radius defining the delivery zone

isStoreDelivery.description: Whether delivery is handled by the store (true) or the platform (false)

isPostDelivery.description: Whether delivery is handled by postal service (true) or own delivery method (false)

isCountry.description: Whether this is a country-wide delivery region (true) or city-specific (false)

minOrderTime.description: Minimum time in minutes required before delivery can be scheduled

deliveryPriceInCents.description: Delivery price for this range in cents

minOrderPriceInCents.description: Minimum order price required for this range in cents

ranges.description: Array of delivery range configurations for distance-based pricing

createdAt.description: The date and time when the delivery region was created

updatedAt.description: The date and time when the delivery region was last updated
